blurb: Fanout's daily paper calendar, its foundational-papers reading order, and its free field notes on AI, systems, and inference engineering.

adaptedFrom.name: Fanout (Suraj Gaud)
adaptedFrom.note: Fanout publishes no open licence on its site; Sikhi University has Fanout's written permission to link this material. No paper summary, blog text, or roadmap diagram is reproduced here — every card opens the real page at fanout.sh.

modules.title: Daily papers
modules.objective: Build a paper-reading habit using Fanout's dated calendar and reading-order map, starting with three foundational papers already explained there.
modules.teach: A new paper goes up daily with a short learning note pitched at why it matters and what to look for, not a full summary — you still have to read the paper. The foundational-papers page is the free map; Fanout's own guided explanations of each one are Pro.

modules.title: Field notes and community
modules.objective: Follow Fanout's technical blog and knowledge map, and see the current state of its open-source robotics curriculum preview.
modules.teach: The blog is where the numbers-driven writing lives — KV-cache formulas, quantization tradeoffs, consistent hashing — each post a self-contained worked calculation rather than a course lesson. Open Robotics is, like the inference engineering course, a public preview of a course Fanout is still building; check its current state before assuming it is finished.
